question: How do mere remnants of what is taken and dropped complete the vivid image?
premises: Something is taken as a mouthful and then abandoned.
Even slight traces of its placing remain.
These remnants are sufficient to complete the image.
inference: Even small remnants of feeding activity fully enrich the contemplated scene.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the mouthful is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Even the slight remnants of what was taken as a mouthful and then dropped are fully sufficient.
